image_spec.headline: A family of four tosses about $2,913 of food every year.
image_spec.body: That's roughly $56 a week. Imagine what you could do with it instead.

posts.caption:
Here's a number worth knowing: the EPA estimates a family of four spends about $2,913 a year on food that never gets eaten. That's around $56 every single week. 💸

The good news? Most of it is avoidable, and small habits add up fast. We're building StashSmart to make those habits effortless.

Follow along so you're first to know when we launch. 💚

#foodwaste #savemoney #groceryhacks #pantryorganization #mealplanning #familybudget #zerowaste #stashsmart
posts.source_note: U.S. EPA, Estimating the Cost of Food Waste to American Consumers (2025): $728 per person, $2,913 per household of four per year.
